title: K003: Add comprehensive mock API unit tests
summary: Comprehensive test suite with 95 test functions covering all 15 new handlers (happy path, invalid body, wrong method), SSE injection (delivery, fan-out, no-clients, invalid JSON), configurable state (replace, invalid, counter preservation), enriched default state fixture (SigningKeys, 5 config sections, Data, SecretRefs), request body capture, concurrent counters (20 endpoints x 100 goroutines), and concurrent inject+configure stress test. All 95 tests pass with -race, go vet clean, golangci-lint clean. Only test file modified. Two minor gaps in completeness: InjectEventCount missing from InitialZero and MixedCalls assertion tests, and register body capture test missing per plan task 3.5.

tests_checklist.item: All 15 new handlers have happy-path tests
All 15 new handlers have wrong-method (405) tests
POST/PUT handlers (except deregister) have invalid-body (400) tests
Enriched state: all 5 config sections verified
Request body capture: register body captured
TestAssertions_InitialZero covers all counter fields including InjectEventCount
Concurrent inject+configure stress test passes with -race
Edge cases covered (disconnect cleanup, initial event preserved, copy safety)

code_quality_checklist.item: Follows existing test patterns (newTestServer, getAssertions, doRequest)
Body constants follow existing registerBody/heartbeatBody pattern
doRequest helper is more general than planned doPut (better)
No dead code or commented-out code
Test names are descriptive and consistent
No magic numbers (100 goroutines defined as const n)

security_checklist.item: No hardcoded secrets (test bodies use mock values)
No sensitive data in test output

architecture_checklist.item: Only test file modified (no production code changes)
Tests are independent (each creates fresh server)
Solution is as simple as possible

dry_yagni_checklist.item: No duplicated code beyond acceptable test repetition
Helper functions (doRequest, getAssertions, getCapturedBody, getState, readSSEEvent) extract reused logic

fail_fast_checklist.item: t.Fatalf used for setup failures that prevent test from proceeding
t.Errorf used for assertion failures that allow test to continue

defensive_checklist.item: All HTTP responses have Body.Close() called
SSE tests use timeouts to prevent hangs

issues_found.description: TestAssertions_InitialZero does not verify InjectEventCount is 0 on fresh server. Plan task 4.1 explicitly requires checking InjectEventCount among the 19+ counter fields. Currently only 20 counters checked, InjectEventCount is missing.
issues_found.fix: Add `if a.InjectEventCount != 0 { t.Errorf("inject_event_count = %d, want 0", a.InjectEventCount) }` after the IntegrityViolationCount check at line 717.

issues_found.description: TestAssertions_ReturnsCorrectCountsAfterMixedCalls does not call /test/inject-event and does not verify InjectEventCount. Plan task 4.2 says to verify all 19+ counter values. The test calls all 19 API endpoints but omits inject-event, leaving InjectEventCount unverified in this test.
issues_found.fix: Add an inject-event call after the integrity-violations call (line 588), then add assertion `if a.InjectEventCount != 1 { t.Errorf(...) }` after the IntegrityViolationCount check at line 651.

issues_found.description: Plan task 3.5 specifies TestLastRequest_RegisterBodyCaptured: POST /v1/register, then GET /test/last-request/register, assert body matches. This test is missing. The existing tests (TestLastRequestBody_InitiallyEmpty, TestLastRequestBody_StoredAfterCapture) use the Go API directly rather than HTTP, and only test drift — not register.
issues_found.fix: Add TestLastRequest_RegisterBodyCaptured: POST /v1/register with registerBody, then GET /test/last-request/register, assert 200, assert body matches registerBody bytes. Place after TestLastRequest_ReturnsCapturedBody.

suggested_improvements: Minor: Consider using table-driven tests for the 15 handler groups to reduce repetition (each handler has identical structure for happy path / invalid body / wrong method). This would reduce the file from ~2569 lines but is not blocking.

Minor: TestConfigureState_InvalidJSON_Returns400 does not verify that the default fixture is still active after the rejected configure-state call (plan task 3.3 mentions this). Consider adding a GET /v1/nodes/node-1/state call after the 400 response to verify state is unchanged.

Minor: Plan task 3.4 mentions updating TestState_ReturnsFixturePeersAndPolicies to check Data/SecretRefs, but the coverage exists in separate TestState_ReturnsDataEntries and TestState_ReturnsSecretRefs tests. Acceptable but diverges from plan.
